senses.gloss: תַּתֵּי (denom. of תַּתָּא) to lower, go down.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 54b:6">Zeb. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>נִיתַתֵּי ביה קליל</he> let us go down a little with it (build it a little lower; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 910">Yalk. Deut. 910</cite> <he>ליחתי ליה פורתא</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 24:1">Yalk. Josh. 24</cite> <he>ניחתא ביה קליל</he>).
<cite ref="Menachot 99a:4">Men. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>מידלי ליה ומִיתַּתֵּי להו לדידהו פורתא</he> it was lifted over and let down (and placed) a little lower than they (the other tables).
<cite ref="Pesachim 8a:9">Pes. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>דמִיתַּתְּיָא</he> (not <he>דמיתתאי</he>) when the bed stands on low legs, opp. <he>דמידליא</he>, v. <cite ref="D00828"><he>דְּלֵי</he></cite>.
